newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares hit by U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares hit by U.S. data.

text.p: Danish share prices failed to achieve expected gains on Wednesday, after higher than expected U.S. March industrial production and capacity utilization depressed bonds at home and on Wall Street.
The KFX top-20 index fell 0.28 point to 151.88 in overall bourse turnover of 1.2 billion crowns.
The KFX June future fell 0.80 point, to 150.90, with 20 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Dealers expected further falls, in a thin market, on Thursday in the wake of Wednesday's opening declines in the Dow.
Nine KFX shares rose, nine fell and two were static.
Most-traded stock was ISS, with 132,750 shares changing hands although its price was little moved, rising 0.51 crowns to 193.51.
Biggest gainer was GN Store Nord, up 20 crowns to 645 although its turnover was only 3,000 trades. --Morten Bonde Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969651
